source_text: I’m sorry, but Friday services have been canceled due to low attendance.

structure.raw_value: BrBaEx.I’m sorry, but Friday services have been canceled due to low attendance.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaEx.I’m sorry, but Friday services have been canceled due to low attendance."

translation: Przykro mi, ale piątkowe nabożeństwa odwołano z powodu zbyt małej frekwencji.

source_text: My name is 1Hero. I’m from the criminal investigations department.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.My name is 1Hero. I’m from the criminal investigations department.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.My name is 1Hero. I’m from the criminal investigations department."

translation: Nazywam się 1Hero. Pracuję w wydziale dochodzeniowo-śledczym.

source_text: Oh! Thank goodness you’re here.

structure.raw_value: JuFrCl.Oh! Thank goodness you’re here.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrCl.Oh! Thank goodness you’re here."

translation: Och! Dzięki Bogu, że już jesteś.

source_text: Welcome, 1Hero. I’m Father Brian Solomon. I’m the new priest here at Eve Cathedral.

structure.raw_value: BrFrEx.Welcome, 1Hero. I’m Father Brian Solomon. I’m the new priest here at Eve Cathedral.
structure.script_literal: "BrFrEx.Welcome, 1Hero. I’m Father Brian Solomon. I’m the new priest here at Eve Cathedral."

translation: Witaj, 1Hero. Jestem ojciec Brian Solomon. Od niedawna pełnię tu posługę, w katedrze Ewy.

source_text: I honestly didn’t expect to see you here so soon.

structure.raw_value: BrFrOp.I honestly didn’t expect to see you here so soon.
structure.script_literal: "BrFrOp.I honestly didn’t expect to see you here so soon."

translation: Szczerze mówiąc, nie spodziewałem się, że przyjdziesz tak szybko.

source_text: Well… I didn’t… I mean… I had some time this afternoon.

structure.raw_value: McBaCl.Well… I didn’t… I mean… I had some time this afternoon.
structure.script_literal: "McBaCl.Well… I didn’t… I mean… I had some time this afternoon."

translation: Cóż… Nie… To znaczy… Miałem dziś po południu trochę czasu.

source_text: Let me ask… How do you know that girl who just left?

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Let me ask… How do you know that girl who just left?
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Let me ask… How do you know that girl who just left?"

translation: Zapytam… Skąd znasz tę dziewczynę, która właśnie wyszła?

source_text: Oh, she’s no trouble maker.

structure.raw_value: JuFrEx.Oh, she’s no trouble maker.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrEx.Oh, she’s no trouble maker."

translation: Och, ona nie sprawia kłopotów.

source_text: I doubt she has anything to do with what we’ve been hearing at night.

structure.raw_value: BrFlOp.I doubt she has anything to do with what we’ve been hearing at night.
structure.script_literal: "BrFlOp.I doubt she has anything to do with what we’ve been hearing at night."

translation: Wątpię, żeby miała coś wspólnego z tym, co słyszymy nocami.

source_text: What have you heard?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.What have you heard?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.What have you heard?"

translation: Co słyszeliście?

source_text: Someone has been rummaging through the church.

structure.raw_value: JuWoEx.Someone has been rummaging through the church.
structure.script_literal: "JuWoEx.Someone has been rummaging through the church."

translation: Ktoś przeszukuje kościół.

source_text: The noise seems to be coming from the storage room, but we’ve not seen anything.

structure.raw_value: BrBaEx.The noise seems to be coming from the storage room, but we’ve not seen anything.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaEx.The noise seems to be coming from the storage room, but we’ve not seen anything."

translation: Hałas dobiega chyba z magazynu, ale niczego tam nie zauważyliśmy.

source_text: I can see you’re concerned with the noises, but don’t you think it’s likely an animal?

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.I can see you’re concerned with the noises, but don’t you think it’s likely an animal?
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.I can see you’re concerned with the noises, but don’t you think it’s likely an animal?"

translation: Widzę, że niepokoją cię te odgłosy, ale czy nie sądzisz, że to pewnie jakieś zwierzę?

source_text: Please! Take this seriously.

structure.raw_value: JuWoCl.Please! Take this seriously.
structure.script_literal: "JuWoCl.Please! Take this seriously."

translation: Proszę! Potraktuj to poważnie.

source_text: You’ll have to excuse Sister Judy. We’ve been through a lot since the death of Father Zephaniah.

structure.raw_value: BrBaEx.You’ll have to excuse Sister Judy. We’ve been through a lot since the death of Father Zephaniah.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaEx.You’ll have to excuse Sister Judy. We’ve been through a lot since the death of Father Zephaniah."

translation: Wybacz siostrze Judy. Wiele przeszliśmy od śmierci ojca Zephaniaha.

source_text: I’m sorry. But it’s just that we’re alone here…

structure.raw_value: JuWoEx.I’m sorry. But it’s just that we’re alone here…
structure.script_literal: "JuWoEx.I’m sorry. But it’s just that we’re alone here…"

translation: Przepraszam. Po prostu… jesteśmy tu sami…

source_text: Father Solomon and I have been trying to get this church back on its feet.

structure.raw_value: JuBaEx.Father Solomon and I have been trying to get this church back on its feet.
structure.script_literal: "JuBaEx.Father Solomon and I have been trying to get this church back on its feet."

translation: Ojciec Solomon i ja próbujemy postawić ten kościół na nogi.

source_text: If you don’t mind me asking... What happened?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.If you don’t mind me asking... What happened?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.If you don’t mind me asking... What happened?"

translation: Jeśli mogę spytać… Co się stało?

source_text: To put it bluntly… Father Zephaniah was a loon.

structure.raw_value: BrBaEx.To put it bluntly… Father Zephaniah was a loon.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaEx.To put it bluntly… Father Zephaniah was a loon."

translation: Krótko mówiąc… Ojciec Zephaniah był szaleńcem.

source_text: Father!

structure.raw_value: JuShOpNo1.Father!
structure.script_literal: "JuShOpNo1.Father!"

translation: Ojcze!

source_text: The church was bleeding members long before I got here.

structure.raw_value: BrBaEx.The church was bleeding members long before I got here.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaEx.The church was bleeding members long before I got here."

translation: Kościół tracił wiernych na długo przed moim przybyciem.

source_text: Father Zephaniah was a strict man…

structure.raw_value: JuSaOp.Father Zephaniah was a strict man…
structure.script_literal: "JuSaOp.Father Zephaniah was a strict man…"

translation: Ojciec Zephaniah był surowym człowiekiem…

source_text: He spoke of the second coming.

structure.raw_value: JuBaEx.He spoke of the second coming.
structure.script_literal: "JuBaEx.He spoke of the second coming."

translation: Mówił o powtórnym przyjściu.

source_text: The second coming? As in the return of your savior?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.The second coming? As in the return of your savior?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.The second coming? As in the return of your savior?"

translation: Powtórnym przyjściu? Masz na myśli powrót waszego Zbawiciela?

source_text: I take it you’re not a religious man.

structure.raw_value: BrFlOp.I take it you’re not a religious man.
structure.script_literal: "BrFlOp.I take it you’re not a religious man."

translation: Rozumiem, że nie jesteś osobą religijną.

source_text: Sorry, Father. Been skipping Sunday school for a long time now.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.Sorry, Father. Been skipping Sunday school for a long time now.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.Sorry, Father. Been skipping Sunday school for a long time now."

translation: Wybacz, ojcze. Od dawna nie chodzę na lekcje religii.

source_text: Zephaniah had an extremist view that drove away members.

structure.raw_value: BrBaEx.Zephaniah had an extremist view that drove away members.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaEx.Zephaniah had an extremist view that drove away members."

translation: Zephaniah miał skrajne poglądy, przez które wierni odchodzili z kościoła.

source_text: He brainwashed the whole convent…

structure.raw_value: BrSaDe.He brainwashed the whole convent…
structure.script_literal: "BrSaDe.He brainwashed the whole convent…"

translation: Wyprał mózgi wszystkim zakonnicom…

source_text: Everyone left, except Judy here.

structure.raw_value: BrFrEx.Everyone left, except Judy here.
structure.script_literal: "BrFrEx.Everyone left, except Judy here."

translation: Wszyscy odeszli, z wyjątkiem Judy.

source_text: I didn’t know Father Zephaniah that well. I only recently moved here after my previous church was destroyed.

structure.raw_value: JuWoEx.I didn’t know Father Zephaniah that well. I only recently moved here after my previous church was destroyed.
structure.script_literal: "JuWoEx.I didn’t know Father Zephaniah that well. I only recently moved here after my previous church was destroyed."

translation: Nie znałam dobrze ojca Zephaniaha. Niedawno się tu przeprowadziłam, po tym jak zniszczono mój poprzedni kościół.

source_text: Sounds like you’ve been through a lot.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Sounds like you’ve been through a lot.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Sounds like you’ve been through a lot."

translation: Wygląda na to, że wiele przeszłaś.

source_text: It’s been a long time since I’ve felt at home.

structure.raw_value: JuSaOp.It’s been a long time since I’ve felt at home.
structure.script_literal: "JuSaOp.It’s been a long time since I’ve felt at home."

translation: Od dawna nie czułam się jak w domu.

source_text: With just the two of us here, Judy’s afraid it’s attracting attention from thieves.

structure.raw_value: BrBaEx.With just the two of us here, Judy’s afraid it’s attracting attention from thieves.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaEx.With just the two of us here, Judy’s afraid it’s attracting attention from thieves."

translation: Jesteśmy tu tylko we dwoje, więc Judy boi się, że przyciągamy uwagę złodziei.

source_text: What do you think, Father Solomon?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.What do you think, Father Solomon?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.What do you think, Father Solomon?"

translation: Co o tym sądzisz, ojcze Solomon?

source_text: I suspect you might just find the thief has four legs.

structure.raw_value: BrFlEx.I suspect you might just find the thief has four legs.
structure.script_literal: "BrFlEx.I suspect you might just find the thief has four legs."

translation: Podejrzewam, że złodziej może mieć cztery łapy.

source_text: Show him around, Sister. Make him feel at home.

structure.raw_value: BrFlOp.Show him around, Sister. Make him feel at home.
structure.script_literal: "BrFlOp.Show him around, Sister. Make him feel at home."

translation: Pokaż mu kościół, siostro. Niech poczuje się jak u siebie.

source_text: Yes, Father Solomon.

structure.raw_value: JuFrOp.Yes, Father Solomon.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrOp.Yes, Father Solomon."

translation: Tak, ojcze Solomon.

source_text: If you’ll follow me, I’ll show you our storage room…

structure.raw_value: JuFrEx.If you’ll follow me, I’ll show you our storage room…
structure.script_literal: "JuFrEx.If you’ll follow me, I’ll show you our storage room…"

translation: Jeśli pójdziesz za mną, pokażę ci nasz magazyn…

source_text: It’s where we believe the noises came from.

structure.raw_value: JuWoEx.It’s where we believe the noises came from.
structure.script_literal: "JuWoEx.It’s where we believe the noises came from."

translation: To stamtąd, jak sądzimy, dochodziły te odgłosy.

source_text: Ah! Not again!

structure.raw_value: ArWoCl.Ah! Not again!
structure.script_literal: "ArWoCl.Ah! Not again!"

translation: Ach! Znowu!

source_text: I know this place!...

structure.raw_value: ArShOp.I know this place!...
structure.script_literal: "ArShOp.I know this place!..."

translation: Znam to miejsce!...

source_text: I’m on Earth!

structure.raw_value: ArShCl.I’m on Earth!
structure.script_literal: "ArShCl.I’m on Earth!"

translation: Jestem na Ziemi!

source_text: Hell yeah, you are! What the hell are you?

structure.raw_value: McWoClNo1.Hell yeah, you are! What the hell are you?
structure.script_literal: "McWoClNo1.Hell yeah, you are! What the hell are you?"

translation: No pewnie, że jesteś! A ty, do diabła, czym jesteś?

source_text: How is this possible? I can’t be here… I never went to Limbo.

structure.raw_value: ArShCl.How is this possible? I can’t be here… I never went to Limbo.
structure.script_literal: "ArShCl.How is this possible? I can’t be here… I never went to Limbo."

translation: Jak to możliwe? Nie mogę tu być… Nigdy nie trafiłam do Otchłani.

source_text: What are you talking about? Where are you from?

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.What are you talking about? Where are you from?
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.What are you talking about? Where are you from?"

translation: O czym ty mówisz? Skąd jesteś?

source_text: I am from the Empyrean, little one.

structure.raw_value: ArFrEx.I am from the Empyrean, little one.
structure.script_literal: "ArFrEx.I am from the Empyrean, little one."

translation: Jestem z Empyreum, malutki.

source_text: You’re a ghost?

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.You’re a ghost?
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.You’re a ghost?"

translation: Jesteś duchem?

source_text: Aren’t you adorable?

structure.raw_value: ArHaOp.Aren’t you adorable?
structure.script_literal: "ArHaOp.Aren’t you adorable?"

translation: Czyż nie jesteś uroczy?

source_text: I don’t understand. Who are you?

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.I don’t understand. Who are you?
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.I don’t understand. Who are you?"

translation: Nie rozumiem. Kim jesteś?

source_text: My name is Arianna. What is your name?

structure.raw_value: ArFrOp.My name is Arianna. What is your name?
structure.script_literal: "ArFrOp.My name is Arianna. What is your name?"

translation: Mam na imię Arianna. A ty?

source_text: I’m… 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.I’m… 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.I’m… 1Hero."

translation: Jestem… 1Hero.

source_text: Hello, 1Hero. I am here to assist you.

structure.raw_value: ArHaOp.Hello, 1Hero. I am here to assist you.
structure.script_literal: "ArHaOp.Hello, 1Hero. I am here to assist you."

translation: Witaj, 1Hero. Jestem tu, żeby ci pomóc.

source_text: The details… I’m not sure.

structure.raw_value: ArWoCl.The details… I’m not sure.
structure.script_literal: "ArWoCl.The details… I’m not sure."

translation: Szczegóły… Nie jestem pewna.

source_text: I thought I had more time to prepare.

structure.raw_value: ArBaDe.I thought I had more time to prepare.
structure.script_literal: "ArBaDe.I thought I had more time to prepare."

translation: Myślałam, że mam więcej czasu na przygotowania.

source_text: Prepare for what?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Prepare for what?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Prepare for what?"

translation: Na co się przygotować?

source_text: I’ve never been to your world…

structure.raw_value: ArFrEx.I’ve never been to your world…
structure.script_literal: "ArFrEx.I’ve never been to your world…"

translation: Nigdy wcześniej nie byłam w twoim świecie…

source_text: It’s…

structure.raw_value: ArBaOp.It’s…
structure.script_literal: "ArBaOp.It’s…"

translation: To…

source_text: It’s a church.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.It’s a church.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.It’s a church."

translation: To kościół.

source_text: Is everything here this ugly?

structure.raw_value: ArWoCl.Is everything here this ugly?
structure.script_literal: "ArWoCl.Is everything here this ugly?"

translation: Czy wszystko tutaj jest takie brzydkie?

source_text: There is dirt everywhere. Who is in charge of cleaning this place?...

structure.raw_value: ArWoCl.There is dirt everywhere. Who is in charge of cleaning this place?...
structure.script_literal: "ArWoCl.There is dirt everywhere. Who is in charge of cleaning this place?..."

translation: Wszędzie jest brud. Kto tu odpowiada za sprzątanie?...

source_text: Is it you?

structure.raw_value: ArWoEx.Is it you?
structure.script_literal: "ArWoEx.Is it you?"

translation: To ty?

source_text: Dirt? I don’t see any dirt.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Dirt? I don’t see any dirt.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Dirt? I don’t see any dirt."

translation: Brud? Nie widzę żadnego brudu.

source_text: Oh, you poor Earthling. You must not be familiar with cleanliness.

structure.raw_value: ArSaOp.Oh, you poor Earthling. You must not be familiar with cleanliness.
structure.script_literal: "ArSaOp.Oh, you poor Earthling. You must not be familiar with cleanliness."

translation: Biedny Ziemianinie. Pewnie nie znasz pojęcia czystości.

source_text: In my world, we do something called... cleaning.

structure.raw_value: ArFrEx.In my world, we do something called... cleaning.
structure.script_literal: "ArFrEx.In my world, we do something called... cleaning."

translation: W moim świecie robi się coś takiego jak… sprzątanie.

source_text: I know what cleaning is.

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.I know what cleaning is.
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.I know what cleaning is."

translation: Wiem, co to sprzątanie.

source_text: Great! Then let’s clean this hideous place up.

structure.raw_value: ArHaOp.Great! Then let’s clean this hideous place up.
structure.script_literal: "ArHaOp.Great! Then let’s clean this hideous place up."

translation: Świetnie! To posprzątajmy to paskudne miejsce.

source_text: If you think this place is bad, then you’re going to hate the rest of the city.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.If you think this place is bad, then you’re going to hate the rest of the city.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.If you think this place is bad, then you’re going to hate the rest of the city."

translation: Jeśli uważasz, że tu jest źle, reszty miasta wręcz nie zniesiesz.

source_text: Oh, my. I didn’t expect this.

structure.raw_value: ArWoCl.Oh, my. I didn’t expect this.
structure.script_literal: "ArWoCl.Oh, my. I didn’t expect this."

translation: Ojej. Nie spodziewałam się tego.

source_text: How the hell are you supposed to assist me?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.How the hell are you supposed to assist me?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.How the hell are you supposed to assist me?"

translation: Jak, do diabła, masz mi pomóc?

source_text: I am the deliverer of God’s will.

structure.raw_value: ArFrEx.I am the deliverer of God’s will.
structure.script_literal: "ArFrEx.I am the deliverer of God’s will."

translation: Przekazuję wolę Boga.

source_text: Uhh... You speak for God?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Uhh... You speak for God?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Uhh... You speak for God?"

translation: Eee… Przemawiasz w imieniu Boga?

source_text: Yes! Now you understand.

structure.raw_value: ArHaOp.Yes! Now you understand.
structure.script_literal: "ArHaOp.Yes! Now you understand."

translation: Tak! Wreszcie rozumiesz.

source_text: This seems crazy… But so is a sexy babe with anatomically correct bird wings.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.This seems crazy… But so is a sexy babe with anatomically correct bird wings.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.This seems crazy… But so is a sexy babe with anatomically correct bird wings."

translation: To brzmi niedorzecznie… Ale seksowna laska z anatomicznie poprawnymi skrzydłami ptaka też.

source_text: I’m a sexy babe? What does that mean?

structure.raw_value: ArShOp.I’m a sexy babe? What does that mean?
structure.script_literal: "ArShOp.I’m a sexy babe? What does that mean?"

translation: Jestem seksowną laską? Co to znaczy?

source_text: Nevermind…

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Nevermind…
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Nevermind…"

translation: Nieważne…

source_text: Okay. If you know the future, then tell me… What is God’s will?

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Okay. If you know the future, then tell me… What is God’s will?
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Okay. If you know the future, then tell me… What is God’s will?"

translation: Dobrze. Skoro znasz przyszłość, powiedz… Jaka jest wola Boga?

source_text: Well let’s see…

structure.raw_value: ArBaOp.Well let’s see…
structure.script_literal: "ArBaOp.Well let’s see… "

translation: No to zobaczmy…

source_text: Today you’re going to visit Wilkes Mansion… Oh! And Heather is going to hand over to you a new home…

structure.raw_value: ArFrEx.Today you’re going to visit Wilkes Mansion… Oh! And Heather is going to hand over to you a new home…
structure.script_literal: "ArFrEx.Today you’re going to visit Wilkes Mansion… Oh! And Heather is going to hand over to you a new home…"

translation: Dziś odwiedzisz rezydencję Wilkesów… Och! A Heather przekaże ci nowy dom…

source_text: You’re so lucky.

structure.raw_value: ArHaOp.You’re so lucky.
structure.script_literal: "ArHaOp.You’re so lucky."

translation: Ale masz szczęście.

source_text: Holy shit! How’d you know that?

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Holy shit! How’d you know that?
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Holy shit! How’d you know that?"

translation: Cholera! Skąd to wiedziałaś?

source_text: Haha. I know everything, cutie.

structure.raw_value: ArHaOp.Haha. I know everything, cutie.
structure.script_literal: "ArHaOp.Haha. I know everything, cutie."

translation: Haha. Wiem wszystko, skarbie.

source_text: Everything?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Everything?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Everything?"

translation: Wszystko?

source_text: Well… Everything that the supreme being has laid out for me to see.

structure.raw_value: ArFrEx.Well… Everything that the supreme being has laid out for me to see.
structure.script_literal: "ArFrEx.Well… Everything that the supreme being has laid out for me to see."

translation: Cóż… Wszystko, co Istota Najwyższa pozwoliła mi zobaczyć.

source_text: Okay… Then tell me. Am I going to solve the Wilkes murder case?

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Okay… Then tell me. Am I going to solve the Wilkes murder case?
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Okay… Then tell me. Am I going to solve the Wilkes murder case?"

translation: Dobrze… To powiedz mi: rozwiążę sprawę morderstwa Wilkesów?

source_text: Uh… I don’t know.

structure.raw_value: ArWoOp.Uh… I don’t know.
structure.script_literal: "ArWoOp.Uh… I don’t know."

translation: Eee… Nie wiem.

source_text: I thought you knew everything.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.I thought you knew everything.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.I thought you knew everything."

translation: Myślałem, że wiesz wszystko.

source_text: I only know it when the time is right. Unless the maker guides me, I am in the dark.

structure.raw_value: ArWoEx.I only know it when the time is right. Unless the maker guides me, I am in the dark.
structure.script_literal: "ArWoEx.I only know it when the time is right. Unless the maker guides me, I am in the dark."

translation: Wiem tylko wtedy, gdy nadchodzi właściwy moment. Bez wskazówek Stwórcy jestem w ciemnościach.

source_text: My powers only work through His almighty guidance.

structure.raw_value: ArFrEx.My powers only work through His almighty guidance.
structure.script_literal: "ArFrEx.My powers only work through His almighty guidance."

translation: Moje moce działają tylko dzięki Jego wszechmocnym wskazówkom.

source_text: Are you okay, 1Hero? Who are you talking to?

structure.raw_value: BrWoOp.Are you okay, 1Hero? Who are you talking to?
structure.script_literal: "BrWoOp.Are you okay, 1Hero? Who are you talking to?"

translation: Wszystko w porządku, 1Hero? Z kim rozmawiasz?

source_text: Father Solomon!… I was just… Praying.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Father Solomon!… I was just… Praying.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Father Solomon!… I was just… Praying."

translation: Ojcze Solomonie!… Ja tylko… się modliłem.

source_text: A quick conversion. Lord be praised.

structure.raw_value: BrFlOp.A quick conversion. Lord be praised.
structure.script_literal: "BrFlOp.A quick conversion. Lord be praised."

translation: Ale szybka przemiana. Chwała Panu.

source_text: I uhhh…

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.I uhhh…
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.I uhhh…"

translation: Ja… Eee…

source_text: Did you find anything in the storage room?...

structure.raw_value: BrBaEx.Did you find anything in the storage room?...
structure.script_literal: "BrBaEx.Did you find anything in the storage room?..."

translation: Znalazłeś coś w magazynie?...

source_text: Perhaps the paw prints of a mischievous cat?

structure.raw_value: BrFlEx.Perhaps the paw prints of a mischievous cat?
structure.script_literal: "BrFlEx.Perhaps the paw prints of a mischievous cat?"

translation: Może ślady łap jakiegoś psotnego kota?

source_text: I did find… A strange…

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.I did find… A strange…
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.I did find… A strange…"

translation: Znalazłem… coś dziwnego…

source_text: Yeah, paw prints. I think you have a cat on the loose.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Yeah, paw prints. I think you have a cat on the loose.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Yeah, paw prints. I think you have a cat on the loose."

translation: Tak, ślady łap. Chyba macie tu kota na wolności.

source_text: Did you tell Judy?

structure.raw_value: BrFlOp.Did you tell Judy?
structure.script_literal: "BrFlOp.Did you tell Judy?"

translation: Powiedziałeś Judy?

source_text: Everything is sorted. I think I helped to put her mind at ease.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Everything is sorted. I think I helped to put her mind at ease.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Everything is sorted. I think I helped to put her mind at ease."

translation: Wszystko załatwione. Chyba udało mi się ją uspokoić.

source_text: Things have been tough around here, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: BrSaEx.Things have been tough around here, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "BrSaEx.Things have been tough around here, 1Hero."

translation: Ostatnio jest tu ciężko, 1Hero.

source_text: I’m sorry we had to bother you.

structure.raw_value: BrSaOp.I’m sorry we had to bother you.
structure.script_literal: "BrSaOp.I’m sorry we had to bother you."

translation: Przykro mi, że musieliśmy ci zawracać głowę.

source_text: It’s no trouble at all. I’m glad I was able to help.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.It’s no trouble at all. I’m glad I was able to help.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.It’s no trouble at all. I’m glad I was able to help."

translation: To żaden problem. Cieszę się, że mogłem pomóc.

source_text: Sounds like quite the storm outside. Care to stay for a bit?

structure.raw_value: BrBaEx.Sounds like quite the storm outside. Care to stay for a bit?
structure.script_literal: "BrBaEx.Sounds like quite the storm outside. Care to stay for a bit?"

translation: Na zewnątrz szaleje niezła burza. Może zostaniesz na chwilę?

source_text: I actually have to run. I have another case I’m investigating.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.I actually have to run. I have another case I’m investigating.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.I actually have to run. I have another case I’m investigating."

translation: Muszę już lecieć. Prowadzę jeszcze inne śledztwo.

source_text: Don’t let me keep you waiting.

structure.raw_value: BrFrOp.Don’t let me keep you waiting.
structure.script_literal: "BrFrOp.Don’t let me keep you waiting."

translation: Nie każ mi na siebie czekać.

source_text: It’s been a pleasure to meet you, Father Solomon.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.It’s been a pleasure to meet you, Father Solomon.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.It’s been a pleasure to meet you, Father Solomon."

translation: Miło było cię poznać, ojcze Solomon.

source_text: I wish you the best.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.I wish you the best.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.I wish you the best."

translation: Życzę ci wszystkiego dobrego.

source_text: Give us a few months. We’ll have this place hoppin’ by Christmas.

structure.raw_value: BrHaOp.Give us a few months. We’ll have this place hoppin’ by Christmas.
structure.script_literal: "BrHaOp.Give us a few months. We’ll have this place hoppin’ by Christmas."

translation: Daj nam kilka miesięcy. Do Bożego Narodzenia będzie tu tętnić życie.

source_text: May the Lord bless your path.

structure.raw_value: BrFrOp.May the Lord bless your path.
structure.script_literal: "BrFrOp.May the Lord bless your path."

translation: Niech Pan błogosławi twojej drodze.

source_text: It’s Heather… The house is ready.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.It’s Heather… The house is ready.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.It’s Heather… The house is ready."

translation: To Heather… Dom jest gotowy.

source_text: Shit… Do I have time to go to the house and still make it to the Wilkes Mansion before Melissa leaves?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Shit… Do I have time to go to the house and still make it to the Wilkes Mansion before Melissa leaves?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Shit… Do I have time to go to the house and still make it to the Wilkes Mansion before Melissa leaves?"

translation: Cholera… Zdążę odwiedzić dom i dotrzeć do rezydencji Wilkesów, zanim Melissa wyjdzie?

source_text: You have plenty of time to do both.

structure.raw_value: ArHaEx.You have plenty of time to do both.
structure.script_literal: "ArHaEx.You have plenty of time to do both."

translation: Masz mnóstwo czasu, żeby zrobić jedno i drugie.

source_text: It’s God’s will.

structure.raw_value: ArFlEx.It’s God’s will.
structure.script_literal: "ArFlEx.It’s God’s will."

translation: Taka jest wola Boga.

source_text: So… I can go to the house first?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.So… I can go to the house first?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.So… I can go to the house first?"

translation: Czyli… Mogę najpierw pojechać do domu?

source_text: But what if I’m late? Can I go to the mansion first and still make it to the home without keeping Heather waiting?

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.But what if I’m late? Can I go to the mansion first and still make it to the home without keeping Heather waiting?
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.But what if I’m late? Can I go to the mansion first and still make it to the home without keeping Heather waiting?"

translation: A jeśli się spóźnię? Mogę najpierw pojechać do rezydencji, a potem do domu, nie każąc Heather czekać?

source_text: Sometimes the order of things doesn’t matter, as long as you follow His will.

structure.raw_value: ArFrEx.Sometimes the order of things doesn’t matter, as long as you follow His will.
structure.script_literal: "ArFrEx.Sometimes the order of things doesn’t matter, as long as you follow His will."

translation: Czasem kolejność nie ma znaczenia, o ile postępujesz zgodnie z Jego wolą.

source_text: This is really strange.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.This is really strange.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.This is really strange."

translation: To naprawdę dziwne.

source_text: You’ll get used to it, cutie.

structure.raw_value: ArHaEx.You’ll get used to it, cutie.
structure.script_literal: "ArHaEx.You’ll get used to it, cutie."

translation: Przyzwyczaisz się, skarbie.

source_text: Your journey is just beginning, 1Hero. But you still have much to learn.

structure.raw_value: ArFrEx^.Your journey is just beginning, 1Hero. But you still have much to learn.
structure.script_literal: "ArFrEx^.Your journey is just beginning, 1Hero. But you still have much to learn."

translation: Twoja podróż dopiero się zaczyna, 1Hero. Wciąż masz się jeszcze wiele nauczyć.

source_text: To start, let’s open your inventory and select your phone.

structure.raw_value: ArHaEx^.To start, let’s open your inventory and select your phone.
structure.script_literal: "ArHaEx^.To start, let’s open your inventory and select your phone."

translation: Na początek otwórz ekwipunek i wybierz telefon.
